hypothesis: v295 promoted after combining contextual exact-top3 with pairwise and current-meet history. The separately promoted v267 multi-window form contrasts are a distinct longer-horizon condition source and may improve the same all-history expert when appended without changing architecture or anchor calibration.

base_model.rule: retain all v295 raw, official-course, pairwise tau20, seven-day meet, model, fold, and gamma-bound definitions unchanged

form_trend.missing: retain NaN for LightGBM native handling
form_trend.source: strictly-prior runner aggregates and current pre-race exhibition only

training.fold_rows: all strictly-prior raw races for each fold
training.screen_rows: fixed candidate acceleration indices after full-series history/form construction
stages: second among five conditioned on first
third among four conditioned on first and second

anchoring.optimizer: deterministic bounded scalar exact-top3 logloss minimization

promotion_requires: v295 delta below zero, race-date bootstrap CI95 upper below zero, and v295 child-family Holm p below 0.05
